subject: [RFC PATCH 05/57] mm/collapse: state what a collapse may do in the policy

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new struct collapse_policy to store the policy decisions made by the caller of the collapse code. The policy is filled in once per scan pass by khugepaged and once per call by MADV_COLLAPSE. This change simplifies the collapse code by removing the need for it to look up who called it, and instead allows it to read from the stored policy. The patch also removes a NULL check in collapse_file() as it is no longer necessary.
